meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

copy.tagline: 通过 signal-cli 设备链接添加 Signal 频道集成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要将 Signal 频道集成到你的应用中
copy.tagline_en: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Signal channels into your application

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以通过 Signal 接收你的消息并回复，就像你用手机上的另一个设备聊天一样。你现有的电话号码会被用作 Claude 的账号。
howto.when: 当你向绑定的 Signal 号码发送消息（包括给自己发 Note to Self）时，Claude 会接收到并自动回复。

say.text: 帮我查一下明天北京的天气
say.note: Claude 会通过 Signal 回复天气信息。

say.text: 写一封邮件给老板，请假明天
say.note: Claude 会处理邮件请求并通过 Signal 回复。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can receive your messages and reply via Signal, like using another device on your phone. Your existing phone number is used as Claude's account.
howto.when_en: When you send a message to the linked Signal number (including Note to Self), Claude receives it and automatically replies.

say_en.text: Check the weather in Beijing tomorrow
say_en.note: Claude will reply with weather info via Signal.

say_en.text: Write an email to my boss asking for leave tomorrow
say_en.note: Claude will process the email request and reply via Signal.
